Apple is working on a second-generation iPhone Air, expected to address several major limitations of the current version. Below is everything currently known about the iPhone Air 2, including features, release date, and other information.

Will there be an iPhone Air 2?

According to reports, iPhone Air sales did not meet Apple's expectations. The Information reported in November that, due to lower-than-expected sales, Apple has postponed the launch of the second-generation model indefinitely.

The report stated that Apple "has notified engineers and suppliers that the next iPhone Air has been removed from the production schedule, with no new release date provided."

However, The Information subsequently updated its report, stating that Apple has not completely cancelled the iPhone Air 2, and the model is still actively under development.

iPhone Air 2 Features

Second Camera

One of the biggest trade-offs of the ultra-thin iPhone Air design is that it comes with only a single camera. According to reports, Apple is working to change this with the iPhone Air 2.

According to sources such as Bloomberg and The Information, the iPhone Air 2 will add a second camera on the back.

Bloomberg indicated that the camera will be an ultra-wide lens rather than a telephoto lens. This will align with Apple's base model iPhone, which also features a main camera and an ultra-wide lens.

A20 Pro Chip

According to reports, the iPhone Air 2 will feature the A20 Pro processor, an upgrade over the current model's A19 Pro.

The A20 Pro chip will be Apple's first iPhone processor to use a 2-nanometer process. The new process will allow the A20 Pro to deliver greater performance and higher efficiency in a similar form factor.

The chip will also adopt another new technology called "wafer-level multi-chip module," which integrates the SoC and DRAM at the wafer level to enhance performance and reduce power consumption.

Better Battery Life

According to reports, Apple is also working to improve the battery life of the iPhone Air 2.

According to supply chain sources, the iPhone Air 2 will feature a 3,500mAh battery. For comparison, the first-generation iPhone Air has a battery capacity of 3,149mAh, representing an increase of more than 10%.

In addition to a physically larger battery, the iPhone Air 2 is also expected to deliver longer battery life thanks to efficiency improvements in the A20 Pro chip.

However, it should be noted that iPhone battery life is affected by many factors. Actual figures can only be confirmed after Apple officially releases the iPhone Air 2.

Vapor Chamber Cooling

According to The Information, the iPhone Air 2 will adopt a vapor chamber cooling system. Apple previously introduced this technology in the iPhone 17 Pro, claiming it significantly improves thermal performance and performance.

If Apple brings vapor chamber cooling to the iPhone Air 2, the device will be able to maintain lower temperatures during high-load operation and sustain high-performance output for longer periods.

iPhone Air 2: Release Date

The iPhone Air 2 was originally expected to be released in September 2026 alongside the iPhone 18 Pro series.

However, the latest report from Bloomberg indicates that Apple plans to launch the iPhone Air 2 in spring 2027, alongside the all-new base model iPhone 18.

What are your thoughts on Apple's iPhone Air 2 plans? Are the changes and improvements Apple is making the right ones? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
